title: Nextdoor Post Reaction Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nextdoor:post reaction_count=*
| stats sum(reaction_count) as total_value, avg(reaction_count) as avg_value by category
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks category values by total and average reaction count across Nextdoor post events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `reaction_count` values for each Nextdoor post event and review total and average reaction count by category.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total reaction count.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which category shows the biggest reaction count numbers in your Nextdoor post data.
